jei.cropgenetics.seed_conversion: Getting genetic seeds: (1) Place ONE Crop Stick on suitable farmland. (2) Right-click with a supported ordinary seed (wheat, carrot, potato, etc.). The planted crop now has baseline Growth/Gain/Strength 1/1/1. (3) Break the planted Crop Sticks to retrieve a Genetic Seed carrying those values. (4) Grow and cross plants to obtain inherited or improved values. TWO Crop Sticks on an empty plot are reserved for crossbreeding: a seed cannot be planted there directly. Only seeds registered by the active crop datapacks are supported; there is no crafting-table conversion.
jei.cropgenetics.seed_analysis: Place the Seed Analyzer as a block. Right-click with a seed to insert one, or open its inventory with an empty hand. Analysis reveals the seed's existing Growth/Gain/Strength values; it does not generate or change them. Unanalyzed Genetic Seeds are nonstackable to preserve their individual genomes. Put a Seed Chest directly beside the Analyzer to see its 27 storage slots in the same menu.
